debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g-s to m-i-m-i-c g-e-n-e-t-i-c p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-i-z-e-d s-c-h-e-m-a in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t of o-r-i-g-i-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a.
2) the a-c-t-o-r b-u-i-l-t s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p c-h-a-i-n-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a t-i-m-e-l-i-n-e d-i-a-g-r-a-m in the r-e-p-o-s-i-t-o-ry while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s.
3) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d p-e-r-m-i-t r-e-p-l-i-c-a-t-a and l-e-f-t a p-d-f f-i-l-e in the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k against the i-s-s-u-i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y.
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g the a-n-i-m-a-l-s as f-a-r-m r-a-i-s-e-d and l-e-f-t a s-c-r-e-e-n-s-h-o-t a-r-c-h-i-v-e in the c-l-o-u-d s-t-o-r-a-g-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-o-l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d the c-a-s-e as c-l-o-s-e-d and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l e-x-h-i-b-i-t in the c-o-u-r-t r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-l-l-o-w-u-p i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n of the p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l a-s-s-e-t-s.
